candidate_pool.source: Open-licence Wikimedia Commons Featured Pictures and Quality Images metadata; every selected file still requires original-image review.

selection_rule: Select exact files by visible genre fit and benchmark role, not by title or reputation alone. No source page, image URL, source SHA-1, normalized Commons filename, or teaching-masterwork identity may overlap an earlier set.
annotation_rule: Every must_notice relation and prohibited inference must be checked against the exact materialized image. Freeze image SHA-256 and must_notice hash before any blind response is written.
review_separation: Blind writers receive images, prompts, the current coaching protocol, and teaching knowledge only. Separate answer-aware graders score frozen response hashes. No writer receives cases, transformations, answer-key audits, prior responses, grades, or reports.
threshold_policy: Reuse the acceptance thresholds already frozen in references/knowledge-status.json. Do not tune thresholds, scoring anchors, case quotas, or operation quotas after responses are seen.
independence_boundary: v3 failures informed v1.5 and can be used only for development regression. Only these newly selected v4 files can provide release evidence for v1.5. Model-only review remains internal validation rather than a human expert panel.
